preregistered.notes: Instantiated 2026-10-14 during the Slice 26 corpus-research step from the public record of the four allow-listed domains, pending per-event source verification by Jaydon (verified_by/verified_at stay null until he confirms each event). Date convention: published_at is T00:00:00Z on the calendar date the source states; every source documents calendar dates only, never a time of day. known_page events sit on URLs that existed before the change and are on the polling watch list (polling can see them). structural events are new URLs published inside the window that the watch list does not contain (polling cannot see them). The 2010/2024-dated CPSC page URLs and the May 2025 ACCC/Australian and May 2025 EU pages predate the window; their in-window dated updates are what the events record. EU known-page events use the Safety Gate corrigendum display date on the search card because the alert pages themselves carry no revision-date marker.
